name: Team Topologies - Platform Engineering Practice
description: A practice governing the design, development, and evolution of the platform as a product, minimizing cognitive load for consumers and establishing clear team interaction modes.

alphas.name: Team Cognitive Load
alphas.description: The measured mental effort required by stream-aligned teams to use the platform. The objective is to reduce this load to maximize fast flow.

states.name: Assessed
states.description: The current cognitive load of consumer teams is quantified and mapped.

checklist.name: Consumer Interviews Conducted
checklist.description: Interviews completed to discover pain points (Non-blocking failure allows moving forward if telemetry exists).

checklist.name: Friction Points Mapped
checklist.description: Specific areas where developers struggle are documented (Blocking failure).

states.name: Bounded
states.description: Clear boundaries are established to prevent cognitive overload.

checklist.name: Responsibilities Capped
checklist.description: Stream-aligned teams are officially relieved of specific infrastructure concerns.

states.name: Optimized
states.description: Cognitive load is continuously monitored and minimized via automation.

checklist.name: Flow Increased
checklist.description: Measurable increase in deployment frequency of stream-aligned teams.

alphas.name: Thinnest Viable Platform (TVP)
alphas.description: The minimum set of APIs, documentation, and tools needed to accelerate the delivery of stream-aligned teams without over-engineering.

states.name: Envisioned
states.description: The core capabilities necessary for the TVP are identified.

checklist.name: Capability Gap Identified
checklist.description: The gap between raw cloud primitives and team needs is documented.

states.name: Defined
states.description: The boundaries and interfaces of the TVP are specified.

states.name: Evolving
states.description: The TVP is iteratively expanded based on consumer feedback.

checklist.name: Feedback Loop Active
checklist.description: Platform telemetry and collaboration sessions actively inform the roadmap.

alphas.name: Team Interaction Modes
alphas.description: The formal behavioral patterns (Collaboration, X-as-a-Service, Facilitation) governing how the platform team engages with other teams.

states.name: Identified
states.description: Required interactions for current platform maturity are mapped.

states.name: Established
states.description: Formal team interaction charters are active.

checklist.name: Collaboration Timeboxed
checklist.description: Heavy collaboration modes are strictly timeboxed to prevent dependency (Blocking failure).

states.name: Seamless
states.description: Interactions fluidly transition between X-as-a-Service and Facilitation.

checklist.name: XaaS Default
checklist.description: X-as-a-Service is the default mode for >90% of platform consumption.

workProducts.name: Team Interaction Charter
workProducts.description: A living document defining how the platform team will temporarily collaborate with or facilitate other teams.

levelsOfDetail.name: Drafted
levelsOfDetail.description: Initial interaction rules and durations proposed.

checklist.name: Duration Set
checklist.description: A specific end-date for deep collaboration is proposed.

levelsOfDetail.name: Enacted
levelsOfDetail.description: Charter is approved and actively governing behavior.

checklist.name: Charter Signed
checklist.description: Both teams agree to the interaction boundaries.

workProducts.name: TVP Architecture Definition
workProducts.description: The declarative specifications and API boundaries of the Thinnest Viable Platform.

levelsOfDetail.name: Sketched
levelsOfDetail.description: High-level API and self-service boundaries proposed.

checklist.name: Capabilities Listed
checklist.description: Core services mapped to cognitive load reduction goals.

levelsOfDetail.name: Specified
levelsOfDetail.description: Formal contracts and IaC templates are defined.

checklist.name: APIs Documented
checklist.description: Self-service APIs are fully documented in the developer portal.

activities.name: Assess Consumer Cognitive Load
activities.description: Conduct surveys, interviews, and telemetry analysis to measure the friction stream-aligned teams face.

activities.name: Establish TVP Boundaries
activities.description: Define the minimum set of capabilities required to abstract underlying complexity without becoming a bottleneck.

activities.name: Execute Timeboxed Collaboration
activities.description: Engage deeply with a stream-aligned team to discover platform gaps, strictly governed by a sunset clause to prevent dependency.

patterns.name: Platform Evolution Lifecycle
patterns.description: The sequential phases of discovering, building, and operating the Thinnest Viable Platform.

patternViews.name: Discovery and Collaboration Phase
patternViews.description: Initial phase prioritizing intense collaboration to map cognitive load and define TVP boundaries.

patternViews.name: X-as-a-Service Operation Phase
patternViews.description: Steady state phase where the platform is consumed autonomously.

workBreakdowns.name: Cognitive Load Assessment Sprint
workBreakdowns.description: Operational breakdown for executing the cognitive load assessment and defining the TVP.

complexity.name: Assessment Complexity Modifier
complexity.description: Accounts for resistance to change or complex legacy technical debt.

task.name: Conduct Developer Friction Interviews
task.description: Interview key engineers across 3 stream-aligned teams. Estimate Unit: Man-Hours.

task.name: Draft Platform Charter
task.description: Draft the interaction boundaries based on friction data. Estimate Unit: Man-Hours.
